profiles.name: Husk
profiles.evidence: Tested on an iPhone 14 Pro running iOS 27 with BloomBox LiveProcess and the Husk-specific JIT script. The user verified Minecraft Dungeons gameplay and landscape display.
profiles.notes: Game Mode needs RAM+ and a configured JIT provider. JIT is attached per launch. If a custom script is required, the user selects it locally; catalog entries cannot download or execute scripts.
